The closest match is about maximizing revenue from battery and electrolyser systems in Danish electricity and ancillary service markets by using measured device behavior in the optimization [1]. It explicitly embeds experimental performance such as ramp limits, efficiency, and setpoint-tracking accuracy into a price-driven framework and reports optimized daily profits for both systems [1].

The other papers are not about income maximization in power exchanges: one is about EV battery power prediction [2], and another is about ranking income fairness in web search and recommendation [3].
